_comment_animation: Path to a GIF, PNG, or folder of numbered frames. Relative paths start from this project folder.
_comment_frame_delay_ms: Delay between frames. Lower numbers play faster.
_comment_scale: Raw multiplier used only when screen_percent is null.
_comment_screen_percent: Preferred size as a percentage of the smaller side of your screen. Try 25, 20, 15, 10, or 5.
_comment_transparent_color: Any pixel with this exact color becomes invisible. Useful for non-alpha images.
_comment_always_on_top: Keeps the animation above other windows.
_comment_click_through: When true, mouse clicks pass through the widget, but you cannot drag or right-click it.
_comment_start_x: Initial horizontal screen position in pixels.
_comment_start_y: Initial vertical screen position in pixels.
